correctness.rationale: For n=2^d two cards in sequential independent fair coordinate swap matchings, the initial highest differing bit J=j gives q_j(w) with weights 0,1/n,2/n. The reduced K=(1/n)I+(n-1)/n 1*pi^T has eigenvalues 1 and 1/n. Uniform first-card address conditional on XOR and the Markov reduction yield P^m=Pi+n^{-(m-1)}(P-Pi), algebraic eigen multiplicities, and TV exact formula, including d=1 boundary. Independently enumerated exact rational pair transitions for d=1,2,3,4; every endpoint agrees.
